data.turoyo: Xori Brahim: W kul man d kətle əštirak bi ʕitaṯe, Aloho mawfeleyo b ġalabe.
data.translation: Khori Brahim: And everyone who has a share in this church, may God repay him abundantly.

rationale: Thin III.1 Infectum cell; left-dislocated contributor and unusual -le-yo sequence, retained with segmentation question. English is supplied project machine translation.

data.turoyo: Xori Brahim: U Moryo Aloho d mawfelən m darbe d haṯe, harke kul mede d howe šafiro w tamo ste d samme ḥəšša baḥ ḥaye d l ʕolam.
data.translation: Khori Brahim: May the Lord God repay them in this way: here, everything that is good, and there too, in that place, in life everlasting.

rationale: Thin III.1 Infectum cell; overt d- optative and plural recipient support the repayment construction. English is supplied project machine translation.

summary: Correct the case government of “entgelten” and “belohnen”
before: um ihn seine Wohltat zu entgelten und gebührend zu belohnen
after: um ihm seine Wohltat zu entgelten und ihn gebührend zu belohnen
rationale: German requires “jemandem eine Wohltat entgelten” but “jemanden belohnen”. The current shared accusative “ihn” does not work for the first verb. The supplied edition translation repeats the same grammatical slip, so this is a grammatical correction, not a claimed discrepancy from the corpus.

summary: Jan Beṯ-Şawoce has no edition translation. English accompanying the added examples is the supplied project machine translation, copied and cut without retranslation; lexical decisions rest on the Turoyo.
The inherited 24/100 kindness recompense example already covers repayment of a benefit rather than only disbursement of money. No new religious reward sense is needed.
d mawfelən provides an optative Infectum frame. Bare mawfeleyo in nearby blessings is compatible with it, but the blessing function alone does not prove a suffix segmentation.
Reader descriptions disagree about -le and -yo as recipient versus theme. Decisions retain the semantic repayment frame without claiming the disputed clitic roles.
Jan 2.10/2786 and Jan 2.12/2860: segment mawfeleyo and identify recipient versus theme. Can either token be Preterit with L-agent, rather than the provisionally retained optative Infectum?
Jan 2.10/2792: confirm the source phrase d samme ḥəšša; the supplied machine English is kept unchanged and does not establish its lexical meaning.
Repayment of church contributions is attributed to God, with abundant or thirty-, sixty- and hundredfold return; this religious context retains the inherited recompense meaning.
